text: ロケットだんの　＊が　しょうぶを　しかけてきた！

patterns.name: 〜てくる
patterns.explanation: てくる after a verb says the action comes toward you. しかけてきた = 'came at you and started (a battle)'.

patterns.name: 〜の (same person)
patterns.explanation: の between a label and a name tells what kind of person the name is; here the label is the group the person belongs to. ロケットだんの　＊ = '＊ of Team Rocket'.
